'''''Kyramla Gemas'rugam'''''&mdash;"Deadly Hairball" in ''[[Mando'a/Legends|Mando'a]]''&mdash;was the name given to a [[jungle wampa]] that [[Mandalore the Avenger|Shae Vizla's]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] kept on [[Tracyn Island]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]]. The [[Wampa/Legends|wampa]] guarded the gate to the Mandalorians' compound, and was [[Death/Legends|slain]] by a group of independent operatives who came to see Vizla.<ref name="Blood Hunt" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Kyramla Gemas'rugam'' first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'', a [[2014]] Digital Expansion to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The wampa is the first boss in the Blood Hunt Tactical Flashpoint.<ref name="Blood Hunt" />
